# Heresay

> In-app feedback where every report gets a hearing. A Report button in an app; a person
> accepts or declines each report; accepted reports become briefs a coding agent can fix; the
> reporter sees the outcome in the app.

This site is one team's own Heresay. Its guides for coding agents are plain Markdown:

- [Start here](/guides/start.md): what Heresay is and the rules
- [Install on the web](/guides/install-web.md): where the script tag goes, per framework
- [Fix a brief](/guides/fix-brief.md): claim, fix, hand off, mark fixed
- [Write the fix note](/guides/write-note.md): the note the reporter reads
- [Docs](/docs.html): script tag options, JavaScript API, limits

Agents connect with `npx heresay connect` in the app's repo (MCP server plus a skill), or use
the same actions through `npx heresay <command>`.
